proposed_from.topic: Sharp action-dependent selective-label bounds for untrialed human-AI deployment. In a finite randomized multi-policy SCM, observe binary ground-truth Z only when endogenous action A reveals it, index common response potentials by distinct externally certified prediction-performance values q, and impose the Zhang-Skalnes-Chen-Oberst unit-level correctness, performance-order, and neutral restrictions. Define the Selective-Label Counterfactual-Correctness polytope over Z and q-indexed action/outcome response types; prove its two LP optima are attained sharp endpoints for the untrialed downstream mean, strictly refine the Z-blind projection on a nonempty relative-open set, and construct finite-sample whole-set inference by intersecting a simultaneous multinomial confidence polytope with the observable-law polytope. Use Euclidean projection for plug-in endpoints and derive projection-composed directional limits with valid m-out-of-n subsampling at simultaneous ties. Include the verified 32-type witness with full [1/2,3/4], blind [1/4,1], and the Imai PSA trial/aihuman consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Finite legal types give O=B(Delta) and every feasible weight vector canonically constructs an attaining SCM, so optimizing the untrialed-outcome coordinate yields the exact sharp interval. Independent enumeration reproduced the 32-type bounds and the relative-interior perturbation full [397/800,601/800] versus blind [99/400,1]. Checks covered same-q collisions, performance ties, empirical infeasibility, boundary laws, endpoint attainment, and classification-risk or policy-value relabeling; no prior-art collision survived. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove conservative conditional quantile validity for centered m-out-of-n subsampling of the joint projection-composed endpoint map when the observable law lies on a projection face and both LPs have multiple optimal bases, including atoms in the directional limit. EARLY KILL TEST: On the 32-type instance, choose a boundary law with simultaneous projection and endpoint ties, enumerate active cones and optimal dual faces, derive the exact Gaussian directional law, and compare centered subsampling for several m/n tending to zero; stop if conservative-quantile convergence fails.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest substantive result is ZhangSkalnesChenOberst2026, Theorem 4.1, whose Tightness of Bounds discussion withholds sharpness and whose Appendix G does not cover endogenous action-dependent revelation. The closest attained-bound construction is ChenOberst2025, Theorems 3.1--3.2, but it predates counterfactual correctness and selective truth. DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 makes the general response-function and confidence-region machinery available, so neither LP compactness nor finite-sample propagation is claimed as novel. The strict delta is the complete three-performance quotient: every legal response type maps to one of thirty-two displayed observable--target columns, positive weights on every generator place the two rational laws in the actual relative interior, and exact programs contract both blind endpoints by \(199/800\) at the perturbed law. Continuity then supplies a nonempty relatively open strict-refinement region.

seed_details.seed: Sharp action-dependent selective-label interval with boundary inference
seed_details.anchor: ZhangSkalnesChenOberst2026, Introduction, Assumptions 3.1--3.3, Theorem 4.1, Tightness of Bounds, Theorem 5.1, Conclusion, and Appendix G.
seed_details.opportunity: Replace conditional-mean branches by the complete legal response-type fiber when truth is revealed only by the endogenous action, prove SCM attainment, and characterize both finite-sample and boundary asymptotic inference.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Before taking conditional extrema, enumerate the joint \(Z\), action, and outcome response types and delete precisely the types violating the three unit-level restrictions; the observable map then masks \(Z\) type by type when \(A=0\).
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining untrialed model impact, counterfactual correctness, selective labels, response-function sharp bounds, and projection inference found ZhangSkalnesChenOberst2026, ChenOberst2025, LakkarajuKleinbergLeskovecLudwigMullainathan2017, BenMichaelGreinerHuangImaiJiangShin2025, and DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024, but no paper at their intersection.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from Duarte et al. because any finite missing-data SCM is already a response-function optimization problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: The general reduction does not specify the legal common-\(q\) type system, prove the application-specific full-versus-blind strict region, derive the two-face projection limit, or resolve the PSA estimand; these are the theorem objects rather than a call to generic software.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed uses the SCM-native M20 compatible-model formulation, includes an exact evaluable LP, endpoint attainment, a relatively open strictness theorem, an inference rung, and a named atomic-limit open question.

seed_details.anchor: ZhangSkalnesChenOberst2026, Conclusion; MastenPoirier2020, breakdown-frontier definition and Theorem 2.
seed_details.opportunity: Allow separate masses \(\delta_{\mathrm{cor}},\delta_{\mathrm{ord}},\delta_{\mathrm{neu}}\) of violating types and derive the smallest budget vector at which a deployment ranking reverses.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain illegal response types and add three linear mass-budget constraints instead of deleting them from the latent simplex.
seed_details.destination_search: MastenPoirier2020 gives the frontier logic and RambachanCostonKennedy2022 gives selective-risk sensitivity bounds, but neither treats the three unit-level human-trust restrictions or an untrialed policy.
seed_details.referee_objection: A routine parametric LP once violating types are assigned arbitrary mass budgets.
seed_details.rebuttal: The critical conclusion region is a three-parameter polyhedral frontier with distinct overlapping violation events, but its scientific value depends on calibrating those budgets; it is retained behind the exact-base-model kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed names a critical budget frontier and not merely monotone widening, but the calibration problem lowers its first-version rank.

seed_details.anchor: Prior proposal \(\texttt{scm\_finiteplate\_bernstein\_ate\_bounds/v1}\), endpoint-SCM attainment; BenMichaelGreinerHuangImaiJiangShin2025, Theorem 3 and Theorem S3.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the common-SCM image for untrialed downstream mean, classification risk, and policy value through its complete support function rather than three unrelated intervals.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the scalar objective by every direction in \(\mathbb R^3\) and prove one latent mixture realizes each exposed point of the image.
seed_details.destination_search: SachsJonzonSjolanderGabriel2023 gives multi-query response-function LP machinery and BenMichaelGreinerHuangImaiJiangShin2025 gives classification-risk bounds, but no located work gives this joint selective-label deployment region.
seed_details.referee_objection: The joint region is only the linear image of the same response-type simplex.
seed_details.rebuttal: Common-SCM joint attainment and interpretable facet recovery matter for multi-criterion deployment, but without an explicit facet theorem this is weaker than the selected scalar strict-refinement kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The support-function representation is explicit, yet the current version lacks a nontrivial closed-form facet family.

seed_details.seed: Tie-inclusive centered subsampling for projection-composed endpoints
seed_details.anchor: FangSantos2019, Theorem 2.1, Theorem 3.1, and Section 4; prior proposal \(\texttt{pid\_slate\_benefit\_partialtransport/v1}\), open face-aware inference question.
seed_details.opportunity: Prove conservative simultaneous endpoint coverage when projection and optimizer ties create atoms, or isolate the smallest legal causal counterexample.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Compute the common active-cone and dual-face derivative before studying conditional quantiles, rather than invoking weak convergence of the endpoint statistic alone.
seed_details.destination_search: AndrewsHan2009 gives endpoint failures and AndrewsGuggenberger2009 gives positive test-based results, but no located theorem covers this exact joint polyhedral composition at atoms.
seed_details.referee_objection: Generic subsampling theory already handles every directionally differentiable statistic when \(m/n\to0\).
seed_details.rebuttal: That inference fails at the exact step from weak conditional convergence to an atomic quantile, and AndrewsHan2009 rules out the generic shortcut.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The limit law and atomic quantile are the named objects; no minimax-converse default is imposed.
seed_details.decision: merged as the selected seed's open-ended question

seed_details.seed: Ordinal recommendations and actions without binary bucketing
seed_details.anchor: ZhangSkalnesChenOberst2026, Conclusion and PSA simplification discussion; BenMichaelGreinerHuangImaiJiangShin2025, Conclusion.
seed_details.opportunity: Define direction-sensitive correctness orders for the six-level PSA score and multiple bail actions, then prove sharp multiclass bounds and strict loss from binary aggregation.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the binary correct--incorrect relation by an ordered confusion-category response map before enumerating legal types.
seed_details.destination_search: LuDingDasgupta2018 handles sharp ordinal potential-outcome comparisons, but no located paper combines ordinal errors, endogenous human action, selectively revealed truth, and an untrialed AI policy.
seed_details.referee_objection: A mechanical increase in the number of response categories.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds unless necessary and sufficient error-direction orders and a strict coarsening-loss theorem are obtained, so the seed is deferred.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The proposal would require an order theorem beyond a larger LP; absent that theorem, it is not selected.

seed_details.anchor: BenMichaelGreinerHuangImaiJiangShin2025, Conclusion; Han2024, dynamic regime welfare LP.

seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace static types by nonanticipating history-indexed response maps and enforce correctness and performance order only on reachable histories.
seed_details.destination_search: Han2024 treats dynamic partial welfare order but not selective truth, model-performance trust, or extrapolation to an untrialed recommendation policy.
seed_details.referee_objection: A state-space explosion with no theorem beyond generic dynamic programming over response histories.
seed_details.rebuttal: A noncomposition theorem could defeat the objection, but the static action-dependent model must be settled first.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The current seed lacks a finite-horizon closed form or noncomposition certificate and is therefore not padded into the core.

seed_details.opportunity: Invert the trial randomization group to obtain exact confidence sets for a finite-population untrialed-policy bound under fixed response types.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Condition on fixed response types and enumerate the assignment orbit before re-solving the endpoint program for every sharp null.
seed_details.destination_search: Randomization-inference searches located exact tests for observed treatment effects but no inversion for an untrialed selectively labeled policy set under performance-indexed restrictions.
seed_details.referee_objection: The unobserved response types prevent imputability of the randomization statistic under the sharp null.

seed_details.opportunity: Choose an untrialed recommendation rule maximizing worst-case downstream value over the response-type fiber and derive regret to the robust oracle.

seed_details.destination_search: Policy learning under ambiguity exists, but no located result uses the Zhang correctness and performance-order class with action-dependent truth revelation.
seed_details.referee_objection: A routine robust empirical-welfare maximization problem once the conditional LP score is available.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected seed is supported by four adjacent threads. First, ZhangSkalnesChenOberst2026 supplies the exact unit-level correctness, performance-order, and neutral restrictions, but Theorem 4.1 is not claimed tight, Theorem 5.1 excludes ties by margin assumptions, and Appendix G leaves general action-dependent missing truth open. ChenOberst2025 proves tightness in the earlier performance-mediated model, confirming that endpoint-SCM construction is the right sharpness standard. Second, LakkarajuKleinbergLeskovecLudwigMullainathan2017 and the PSA papers ImaiJiangGreinerHalenShin2023 and BenMichaelGreinerHuangImaiJiangShin2025 establish the action-induced label mechanism and the trial consumer, but their contraction and baseline-potential-outcome methods do not impose the selected response-order system. Third, DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 and SachsJonzonSjolanderGabriel2023 establish finite response-function optimization and sharp endpoint attainment for discrete causal models, but not the named selective-label polytope, strict full-versus-blind region, or untrialed-performance interpretation. Fourth, KaidoMolinariStoye2019, FangSantos2019, HongLi2018, and AndrewsHan2009 delimit the inference frontier: projection and LP maps are directionally differentiable, ordinary resampling may fail, and atomic centered-subsampling quantiles require a separate theorem. The two surviving alternatives draw on MastenPoirier2020 and RambachanCostonKennedy2022 for violation budgets, and on SachsJonzonSjolanderGabriel2023 plus BenMichaelGreinerHuangImaiJiangShin2025 for a joint deployment region; neither closer thread subsumes the selected scalar sharpness and strictness kernel.
